author: ywkao
body:
This PR adds geometry ROOT files and metadata used by the HGCAL DQM plugins introduced in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52126. The ROOT files contain TGraph objects used to build polygonal maps of modules and channels in the summary plots. File | Description -- | -- DQM/geometry\_{type}\_TC\_wafer.root | Trigger cells in a module DQM/geometry\_{type}\_wafer.root
DQM/geometry\_{type}\_tileboard.root | DAQ channels in a module (silicon wafers and SiPM-on-tile boards) DQM/geometry_v16p6.root | All HGCAL modules (module-position template, geometry v16.6) DQM/dqm_quality_threshold.json | Metadata for the DQM plugins (ECON-D/ECON-T quality-grading thresholds) The total size is about 38 MB, most of it in `geometry_v16p6.root` (about 37 MB). `README.md` is updated to describe the new `DQM/` directory.
title: Add HGCAL DQM geometry templates and quality thresholds
